title: Preserve receive shutdown joining after a poisoned federation receive counter
outcome: A poisoned receive counter cannot make shutdown finish before its outstanding receives, while admission remains fenced.
acceptance: join_receives handles counter poison consistently with receive-job teardown and continues waiting for outstanding receives to reach zero; supervisor cleanup and join-before-persistence ordering remain intact.
A controlled poison regression retains at least one receive during shutdown and proves joins stay pending until release, then complete before persistence; no admission is granted after stopping.
The change preserves exact receive accounting and states any assumptions about poison sources rather than treating arbitrary corrupted accounting as safely recoverable.
